title: Reclaim 0.1.1-1567
body:
<!-- synopkgland:release:synopackageland%2FSynoReclaim:0.1.1-1567 -->

Reclaim **0.1.1-1567**

### en

0.1.1-1567
- Overview, Explore, Snapshots and Packages keep page notes behind the info button beside the title.
- Stale reports are indicated only by the status badge at the top right.
- Settings lets administrators enable or remove the App entry, including after reinstalling.
- A visible DSM portal banner shows the App name without repeating it in the sidebar.

### zh-TW

0.1.1-1567
- 總覽、探索、快照與套件頁將附註收進標題旁的資訊入口。
- 報告過期僅在右上角狀態標籤提示。
- 管理員可在設定中啟用或移除 App 入口，重裝後也可啟用。
- DSM Portal banner 顯示時，側欄不重複顯示 App 名稱。

Package: `synopackageland/SynoReclaim`

[Browse packages / 瀏覽套件](https://synopkgland.com/apps/)
